sources.description: One prospect who may interest the Denver Broncos on Day 3 of the 2026 NFL Draft is the University of Buffalo linebacker, Red Murdock. He is a 6-2, 232-pound linebacker who is one of the more physical and hard-hitting linebackers in this entire draft. The Athletic’s lead draft analyst, Dane Brugler, has Murdock ranked as […]
